root_cause.defence: set_fp16_ovfl() (MODE.FP16_OVFL: saturate fp16 overflow to +-65504, set in the codec constructor before the cast) covers exactly this condition but is compiled only #if defined(__gfx942__): absent on gfx950 (gpu_objects.py ARCH_DIFF s_setreg 39/39 gfx942 vs 0/39 gfx950); the codecs' kRangeMin/kRangeMax clamp runs after the cast; even saturated, the value would be wrong (65504)
conditions: default VLLM_ROCM_QUICK_REDUCE_CAST_BF16_TO_FP16=True: bf16 payload cast to fp16
all-reduce >= 2 MiB (TP2 fp16 INT8 minimum): 1024-token prefills
a finite activation outlier above fp16 max (1.833e5 on rank 0)
